name: exemplar_a_clean
text:
Subject: the deals that don't make your 86%

Jim,

An 86% close rate across 1,200 deals is about three times the field, so you know the other 14% better than anyone: the businesses where the value walks out the door with the owner.

That is the gap I close. I build the systems that move the day to day off the owner and lift the margins in the year or two before a sale, so an owner-dependent business becomes one a buyer will pay up for.

I want to partner with a few brokers on referrals. You point me at an owner who isn't quite sellable yet, I do the operational work, and what comes back is a deal that makes your 86%, at a higher number.

A higher price for you, a cleaner close, and something to offer sellers you'd otherwise turn away.

Buy-side background, CA and CFA, and I build the systems myself.

Worth a short call?

Patrick Nesbitt, CA(SA), CFA

name: exemplar_b_clean
text:
Subject: where your selling guides stop

Matthew,

Your guides get sellers to the start line, and the law-practice one is the sharpest case: the firm is the lawyer, and a buyer knows it.

That handover problem is what I work on. I build the systems that move the client relationships and the daily judgment off the owner in the year or two before a sale, so the business is worth more when it lists.

I want to partner with a few brokers on referrals. You point me at an owner a year or two out, I do the operational work, you sell a bigger, cleaner deal.

Worth a short call?

Patrick Nesbitt, CA(SA), CFA
